digest.component_or_area: CLI mutating verbs (link, unlink, comment, tag, edit, etc.)
propositions: Mutating verbs (link, unlink, comment, tag, edit, set-file-impact, etc.) must emit one-line kubectl-style confirmation to stdout on success to distinguish idempotent no-ops from actual writes, eliminating spurious agent retries caused by indistinguishable silent output.

Idempotent no-op paths must print 'no change: <reason>' with exit 0 and no event write, while successful mutations print '<past-tense-verb> <args-summary>' with no follow-up store read required to build the confirmation.

Global --quiet/-q and --output/-o flags must be extracted at the router level before verb dispatch to uniformly suppress confirmation lines and emit JSON envelopes across all verbs including positional-only _REGISTRY leaves (comment, tag, untag, archive, set-verify-commands).

Already-printing verbs (create, idea, revert, claim, session-log, transition) and newly-covered reopen must normalize to the shared confirmation contract preserving all output data with zero information loss.
REDIRECT records from link must remain byte-identical before and after the change and under --quiet, printing as the sole stdout result with no additional confirmation line layered on top.

Existing consumed seam returns (e.g., add_dependency's dict | None REDIRECT contract) must be unchanged; confirmation signals added only as parallel channels, never altering the consumed value's type or meaning.
